WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    SUM(gross_sales - discount_amount - COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS net_sales,
    SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(orders) AS orders,
    SUM(gross_sales) AS gross_sales,
    SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount,
    SUM(COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS refund_amount
  FROM data
  GROUP BY date
),
daily_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, NTILE(2) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS half
  FROM daily
),
daily_indexed AS (
  SELECT *,
         date_diff('day', (SELECT MIN(date) FROM daily), date) AS day_index
  FROM daily
),
daily_lagged AS (
  SELECT *,
         LEAD(net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS net_sales_next
  FROM daily_indexed
),
campaign_summary AS (
  SELECT
    campaign,
    SUM(gross_sales - discount_amount - COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)) AS net_sales,
    SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend
  FROM data
  GROUP BY campaign
)
SELECT
  'period' AS analysis,
  CASE WHEN half = 1 THEN 'first_half' ELSE 'second_half' END AS label,
  SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales,
  SUM(ad_spend) AS ad_spend,
  SUM(net_sales) / NULLIF(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS roas,
  SUM(orders) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS conversion,
  SUM(refund_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_sales), 0) AS refund_rate,
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS share_net_sales
FROM daily_ranked
GROUP BY half
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'campaign',
  campaign,
  net_sales,
  ad_spend,
  net_sales / NULLIF(ad_spend, 0) AS roas,
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  net_sales / NULLIF(SUM(net_sales) OVER (), 0) AS share_net_sales
FROM campaign_summary
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'trend',
  'net_sales_slope_per_day',
  regr_slope(net_sales, day_index),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
FROM daily_indexed
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'trend',
  'ad_spend_slope_per_day',
  regr_slope(ad_spend, day_index),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
FROM daily_indexed
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'correlation',
  'ad_spend_vs_same_day_net_sales',
  corr(ad_spend, net_sales),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
FROM daily_indexed
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'correlation',
  'ad_spend_vs_next_day_net_sales',
  corr(ad_spend, net_sales_next),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE),
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)
FROM daily_lagged
ORDER BY analysis, label;

payload.text:
Verification:
- 净销售额按 `gross_sales - discount_amount - COALESCE(refund_amount, 0)` 计算，并按日期汇总后比较前后半段；数据共 59 天、1416 行，未使用会产生重复的 join。
- 后半段净销售额约 1019.05 万，较前半段 1063.20 万下降约 4.2%；同期广告支出从约 11.05 万升至 14.81 万，增长约 34.0%，ROAS 从 96.2 降至 68.8。
- 退款率由 2.41% 升至 3.58%，转化率基本持平；广告支出与次日净销售额相关性约 -0.009，当日相关性仅 0.29。
Conclusion:
不建议“整体加大投放”。当前数据显示投放增加但净销售额下降、ROAS 走弱，且广告对次日销售几乎没有领先相关性。应先控制退款/折扣、排查需求下滑；若投放，只对高 ROAS 且可验证增量收益的 campaign（如“新品组合推荐”）做小额测试，不宜全面加投。
